distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.8261 +/- 0.0192 mas (same row, RUWE 1.36): 92.37 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.25423 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TIC 139702105 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract): 872,568 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.968 (0.928 to 1.008) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
